artworks.title: Pines on a Mountaintop at Night
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: The image depicts a dense, wooded landscape dominated by large coniferous trees. The horizon is low, almost obscured by the trees. Fine details and textured brushstrokes add depth to the trees and rocks. Closest to the viewer is rocky terrain with vegetation, leading to a dense array of trees. The color palette is primarily shades of gray and black, creating a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Trees with Tangled Roots
artworks.creditLine: Gift of C. G. Boerner LLC, in honor of Rena Hoisington
artworks.description: The image is a monochrome etching depicting a forest scene. The observer is on the forest floor looking slightly upward at a cluster of large trees. The etching features intricate roots sprawling across the ground, with trees rising behind them. The horizon is obscured by foliage and tree trunks, creating a closed visual space. The style includes detailed lines and cross-hatching to depict textures of bark, leaves, and roots. The color palette is grayscale, emphasizing line work and contrast. Additional trees are visible in the distance, blending into the shaded background to add depth to the composition.

artworks.title: Soldat Blessé (Wounded Soldier)
artworks.artist: Antoine Maxime Monsaldy, after Jean-Germain Drouais

artworks.title: Artemisia
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a figure leaning over a funerary urn. The scene is rendered in black lines, showing a detailed figure with long hair and intricate clothing in a sad pose. The figure is huddled around a large urn adorned with decorations and a sign that reads "WE A.C.P." In the background, there is an obelisk with reliefs and inscriptions, statues on pedestals, trees, and a cloudy sky. The drawing showcases refined linework and shading to create texture and depth, conveying a somber visual narrative hinting at mourning or loss.

artworks.title: Lucretia
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a seated woman with most of her body visible. She is leaning slightly forward with her head turned to the side, her right hand covering her face. Her hair is styled in an updo, pulled back from her face. She wears a flowing robe or gown, and there are ornate elements around her, including a sculpted piece with swirling designs. She holds a slender dagger in her left hand. The background is simple, possibly suggesting an interior setting with subdued decor.

artworks.title: Study for "Rachel Came with Her Father's Sheep" (recto);  The Death of Rachel (verso)
artworks.medium: a.) watercolor over graphite; b.) watercolor over graphite
artworks.description: The image shows a figure and a group of animals in a pastoral setting. The horizon is positioned about a third of the way down from the top of the image, with a sky filled with horizontal, cloud-like patterns. Tall, leafless trees extend vertically through the image. The brushstrokes are loose and defined, with careful linework outlining the figure and sheep close to the viewer. The color palette is muted, with light browns and soft greens dominating the scene. The figure is to the left, surrounded by grazing sheep.

artworks.title: Oberwesel on the Rhine
artworks.medium: watercolor on paper mounted on board

artworks.title: A Drover with Sheep, a Church Beyond
artworks.medium: watercolor and graphite heightened with white gouache
artworks.description: This image shows a low vantage point of a country path with a small flock of sheep being guided by a person dressed in red. Trees line the path, and in the distance, a church tower is visible against the sky. A line of slender trees and the church tower break the horizon. The brushstrokes are soft, creating a blurred effect. The color palette is muted, with deep greens and browns dominating the scenery against a grey and blue sky.

artworks.title: Troncs d'arbres, Fontainebleau (Tree Trunks, Fontainebleau)
artworks.description: The image shows a monochromatic photograph featuring three large trees with rough bark in a natural setting. The horizon appears low, just behind the trees, revealing a sunlit patch of grass. The composition lacks visible brushstrokes and showcases a contrast between the textured tree trunks and the soft background foliage and light, creating a serene atmosphere in a natural landscape.

artworks.title: A Bouquet of Flowers in a Wicker Basket
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: Title Page
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing depicting two nude figures on a cloud-like surface. One figure holds a chain connected to a star-like object, mirroring by the other figure. An ethereal figure hovers above them, reaching towards a large swirling disk-like object in the center. A scroll with Latin writing is below the figures. The style is reminiscent of Hendrik Goltzius, known for intricate engravings and mythological themes. The circular composition suggests balance, while the detailed engraving gives a sense of depth and texture.

artworks.title: Dies I (First Day)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three muscular figures floating in a dynamic pose. The composition features three nude figures in an environment of clouds or swirling drapery. One figure on the left has outstretched arms and vibrant, wavy hair. Another figure above holds a chain or rope, and the third figure on the right emerges from swirling drapery, facing the central action. The scene is circular, giving a sense of continuous movement and balance. The detailed line work and shading highlight the anatomy and textures of the figures and setting. Chiaroscuro adds depth and contrast to the composition.

artworks.title: Dies II (Second Day)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: There is a drawing of mythological figures in clouds. A bearded figure wearing a crown of leaves is pouring water from a jug while reclining on a cloud. Two other figures with wings are floating above, each holding a rod or cane. The background shows swirling clouds and a radiant light.

artworks.title: Dies III (Third Day)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures. The composition features three muscular figures in a circular space filled with clouds. The central figure has wings and holds two objects resembling branches or staff with foliage. The figure on the left is seated with a headdress of leaves or flowers. The figure on the right is reclining and extending a hand towards the center, with a floral wreath or crown on their head. The shading and linework provide depth and texture, creating a dynamic scene with movement and energy surrounded by swirling clouds.

artworks.title: Dies IV (Fourth Day)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of mythological figures amidst clouds and divine symbols. The composition presents a central figure with a muscular physique, standing on clouds and raising one arm dramatically while holding a quiver of arrows and a bow. Next to this figure is another, draped in cloth with a soft, gentle posture. To the right, another figure, nude with a flowing drapery, grasps a crescent shape with one hand while holding a staff or rod in the other hand. The figures seem to be placed within a celestial or divine setting, highlighted by an encompassing oval frame. The intricate shading and detail reflect the style of classical mythology often depicted in Renaissance or Baroque art.

artworks.title: Dies V (Fifth Day)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing featuring a nude figure and various animals in a mythical landscape. The scene shows the central figure sitting on a fish-like creature next to a body of water. The figure is adorned with a headdress that includes shells and fruits. The landscape is filled with animals, including birds in flight, perched on trees, and on the ground, alongside exotic land creatures. The image is in a circular format, resembling a medallion or ornamental plate. The detailed line work and blend of natural and imagined elements create an enchanting and mythic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Dies VI (Sixth Day)
artworks.creditLine: Ruth and Jacob Kainen Memorial Acquisition Fund
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a mythological or religious scene. It depicts three prominent figures in a circular composition with intricate detailing and careful shading. The central figure stands gracefully, surrounded by swirling cloud-like shapes. They appear to be interacting with another figure hovering above who is draped in flowing robes and extending an arm. Below them, another character is reclining as if asleep. The background features an elaborate landscape with trees and a flowing river, providing a lush setting. The artwork's engraving style is reminiscent of Renaissance techniques, capturing both drama and serenity.

artworks.title: The Skylark
artworks.description: The image shows a pastoral scene with a man and a dog near a wooden gate. In the distance, there is a landscape with a fence, trees, hills, and a textured sky. The etching technique creates detailed lines for depth and texture. The color palette is monochrome with shades of black and grey.

artworks.title: Estate (Summer or Ceres)
artworks.artist: Cherubino Alberti, after Polidoro da Caravaggio
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image shows a classical-style figure enclosed within a triangular ornamental frame. The figure is seated with one arm raised and the other resting on the knee. The facial features are rendered in a classical, idealized style, with soft features and flowing wavy hair. The figure is dressed in a draped garment and holds a large bouquet of foliage. The background has a hatch pattern, and the word "ESTATE" is inscribed at the top of the triangular panel.

artworks.title: The Inner Forest (Intérieur du bois)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on tan laid paper
artworks.creditLine:
Gift of James A. Bergquist, Boston,
in honor of Shelley R.Langdale
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from an elevated point showing a grove of trees with two figures and various animals. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the dense foliage filling the frame. The intricate etching technique uses dense lines and hatching to create textures on the leaves, bark, and ground. The figures are sitting under a tree with animals nearby. The artwork is in black ink on light-colored paper.
